about: Vaughan is a suburban city in York Region, northwest of Toronto. It grew rapidly from rural townships into industrial parks, subdivisions, and a subway-linked downtown at Vaughan Metropolitan Centre. Canada’s Wonderland sits on the city’s northern edge. About 320,000 people live in Vaughan.
seoSummary: Northwest GTA suburb with Canada’s Wonderland and a new subway downtown.
knownFor: Vaughan Metropolitan Centre and the TTC subway extension
